threatModel.quote: We assume all sequencers can be malicious by controlling the host of TEEs with at most f sequencers' TEEs are compromised at any time. ... The parameter f can be determined by the rollup service provider.

staticCorruption.quote: We assume static corruption by the adversary, where a fixed fraction of all sequencers' TEEs is compromised.
staticCorruption.locator: Sec. III-B Threat Model, Case 4 (v3 HTML)

threatModel.cases: Case 1 诚实+未破；Case 2 诚实+已破；Case 3 恶意+未破（可操控 I/O，导致可用性丧失）；Case 4 恶意+已破（无完整性/机密性保证）

setup.quote: We deployed our evaluation on up to 20 nodes, with the distribution of SGX, TDX, and CSV distributed in a ratio of 1:2:2. ... For WAN experiments, the inter-node Round-Trip Time (RTT) is about 25 ± 0.1ms. For LAN experiments, the inter-node RTT is about 0.5 ± 0.03ms.
setup.locator: Sec. VI-A (v3 HTML); Table III System Parameters

values.network: LAN RTT 0.5±0.03 ms / WAN RTT 25±0.1 ms

clockDefinition.quote: two 'chess clock' timers are used. These clocks are initialized to some amount of time called the challenge period. ... The challenge period must be large enough to allow an honest party to make all of their moves and to account for censorship. ... the challenge period should be set to (at least) Cmax+D

verifiedSourceFacts.quote: Compute the duration of the next clock ... by adding the duration of the grandparent claim to the difference between the current block timestamp and the parent's clock timestamp.

verifiedSourceFacts.item: 时钟延期规则（标准/预执行轨迹根/预单步）
verifiedSourceFacts.quote: MAX_GAME_DEPTH-1: CLOCK_EXTENSION + oracle().challengePeriod(); SPLIT_DEPTH-1: CLOCK_EXTENSION * 2; 否则 CLOCK_EXTENSION

thirdPartyContinuation.evidence: 时钟继承 + CLOCK_EXTENSION 机制明确允许第三方在继承他人时钟时获得延期；spec 说明该延期正是为了『combat the situation where a challenger must inherit a malicious party's clock when countering a freeloader claim, in order to preserve incentive compatibility for the honest party』
thirdPartyContinuation.implication: 本方案**不得**宣称『第三方接续/争议图动态参与』为首创；这已是 OP FDG 的既有机制
